calls.statement:
SELECT store_key, store_id, store_name, city, region, format, sqm, open_date, close_date, valid_from, valid_to, is_current
FROM dim_store
WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE sqm >= 3000) OR store_id >= 900 OR close_date IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sqm DESC, store_id, valid_from

calls.statement:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT r.store_id, sum(r.net_sales) AS net_sales, count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.net_sales <> 0) AS days_with_sales
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND r.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY s.net_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, s.store_id, c.store_name, c.sqm, rank() OVER (ORDER BY c.sqm DESC) AS sqm_rank, round(s.net_sales) AS net_sales, s.days_with_sales
FROM s JOIN dim_store c ON c.store_id = s.store_id AND c.is_current
ORDER BY s.net_sales DESC LIMIT 16

SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY sqm DESC) AS size_rank, store_id, store_name, sqm
FROM dim_store
WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900 AND close_date IS NULL
QUALIFY rank() OVER (ORDER BY sqm DESC) <= 10
ORDER BY sqm DESC
